label: Multi select
description: Several options chosen from one choice list, such as labels, affected services, or skills. The record stores an array of unique option IDs. Use single_select when exactly one option applies.
usage: Use for tags and classifications where several apply at once.
Set maxItems to keep values meaningful (5–10 for labels).
Do not use a multi select to drive assignment or workflow; use a single_select for that.
constraints: choiceList is required and must reference an existing choice list.
Values are unique option IDs; duplicates are removed on write and order is preserved.
An empty selection is stored as an empty array, never null.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Alt+Down opens the list; Space toggles the focused option; Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip; Esc closes.
accessibility.notes: Uses aria-multiselectable on the listbox; selected options are chips with a remove button named "Remove <label>".

responsive: Chips wrap within the cell; the list opens as a bottom sheet below 720px.
